selectionMethod: Official catalogue API snapshot cross-checked against the UI first render and fully expanded 8→204 Browser state.
normalizationNotes: For 33 promoted units, current price comes from discount.stock.data[0].priceWithDiscount; totalPriceWithDiscount incorrectly equals the undiscounted totalPrice in every source row.
Old price is emitted only when the official nested promotion price is lower than totalPrice.
Unit deadLine is consistently one calendar day earlier than the matching realEstateList block.deadline; normalized completion.date uses the block deadline and preserves sourcePlacementDate.

The live API exposes official numeric block names but no supported mapping from block IDs to marketing aliases Nur/Kaya/Sham/Safa/Tumar/Orin/Samar/Zar; building.name stays verbatim to avoid inventing aliases.
Three Comfort-1 units publish floorplan URLs that return 404 in every size and on the detail API; floorplan.available is false for them.
All 204 rows have isSale=true, while source statuses are internal CRM labels (Снятие резерва / Расторжение / Снятие брони); normalized availability follows isSale and inclusion in the live catalog.
